annotations.title: Check tax-exempt status and missing years

description: Whether the IRS automatically revoked an organization's tax exemption (revocation, posting and reinstatement dates), and which of its last three ended accounting years have no return on the IRS public files. Three consecutive missing years revoke the exemption (IRC 6033(j)).

ein.description: Employer Identification Number, 9 digits, with or without the dash (12-3456789)
